[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالتثنية)#581/r1] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Dual nouns take alif plus nūn in the nominative and yāʾ plus nūn in the accusative and genitive; ordinary non-defective, non-hamzated nouns form the dual by opening the final consonant.
